definitionZh: *scroll-marker-group CSS伪元素是在卷轴容器内生成的,包含卷轴容器后代生成的任何 *scroll-marker伪元素.
sourceDefinition: The ::scroll-marker-group CSS pseudo-element is generated inside a scroll container and contains any ::scroll-marker pseudo-elements generated on descendants of the scroll container.
